proposal.utterance: Classify 'the 2026 trial of X vs. Y'.

entities.label: 2026TrialXvsY
entities.rationale: A specific named trial is a particular legal proceeding that unfolds in time — paradigmatically a BFO Process. It is an individual (proper name referring to a specific event), not a class.

entities.label: Year2026
entities.rationale: The year 2026 is a specific temporal region (a one-dimensional temporal interval) in which the trial occurs. BFO_0000038 (one-dimensional temporal region) is the appropriate type for a calendar year.

entities.label: Trial
entities.rationale: Trial as a common noun denotes a kind of legal process. Minting a class working:Trial as a subclass of BFO_0000015 Process to serve as the type of the individual 2026TrialXvsY.

relations.rationale: The individual 2026TrialXvsY is an instance of the class Trial.
Trial is a kind of Process in BFO.
BFO_0000199 (occupies temporal region) locates the trial within the temporal region Year2026. This is the standard BFO relation between a process and the temporal region it occupies.

open_questions: Are X and Y persons, corporations, or other entities? If so, they can be added as individuals (likely Material Entities or Legal Persons bearing roles such as Plaintiff and Defendant) participating in the trial via RO_0000056.
Should 'Trial' be further typed as a subclass of a more specific legal process class (e.g., CivilTrial, CriminalTrial)?
Is the year 2026 the full temporal extent of the trial, or merely when it began or was scheduled? This affects whether BFO_0000199 (occupies) or a weaker temporal relation is appropriate.
Do you want to record the jurisdiction (a Site, BFO_0000029) in which the trial takes place?
proposal.rationale_summary: The utterance 'the 2026 trial of X vs. Y' names a specific, historically particular legal proceeding. In BFO terms, a trial is a Process (BFO_0000015) — an occurrent that unfolds over time and has participants. The definite description picks out an individual, not a kind, so it is modeled as an individual (working:2026TrialXvsY) of type working:Trial, where working:Trial is a new class subsumed under BFO_0000015. The year 2026 is typed as a one-dimensional temporal region (BFO_0000038), and the trial is related to it via BFO_0000199 (occupies temporal region). No existing classes or individuals in the working ontology directly cover a trial as a process individual, so new entities are minted. Key open questions concern the identity and typing of the parties X and Y, the kind of trial, and jurisdictional context.
